evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Name: Garrison Bennett; Moving day: Sunday October 11th morning; Route: 3101 South Lamar Boulevard to 10820 south interstate 35, Austin; Size: one bedroom, ~1100 sq ft current
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Do you have any concerns or any important things that you wanted to answer during this call today? [Asked after availability check, but before detailed probing started—after initial property type question but early in call]
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Floor/stories both locations (3rd floor with elevator, 2nd floor stairs); property type (apartment both); walking distances (20 yards to elevator, ~250-300 feet within building; 10-15 feet to stairs, 30 feet to door); furniture items (couch, coffee table, desk, mattress); access concerns checked; box count estimated (15-25 boxes)

So we'll send out two movers and one truck estimated time is between three to four hours. Estimated cost would be $840

evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: We value your time. So, if you cannot make it to the time window that we arrange, we immediately start discounting money of your final bill
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: We have no worry damage coverage included on the ad we that you're paying us, we will provide up to 2000 dollars per Mai that is to repair, replace and reimburse for your items
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Rep does not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or similar closing confirmation
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Would you like our help with your move? [Asked plainly, customer asked clarifying question rather than saying no, then rep asked again: I just wanted to ask if you wanted us to lock that in for you and help you out with regards to your upcoming move]
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: There's no deposit required, no recent occurring your spot
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Date (Sunday 11th October, 8:30-9:00 AM) and phone number confirmed via earlier contact capture; arrival window (8:30-9:00 AM) stated; crew size (2 movers, 1 truck) mentioned; addresses captured in discovery; no crew notes left about customer concerns

top_strength: Rep gathered comprehensive logistics details (floor, walking distances, furniture, special items, box count) and delivered pricing framing with transparent fee structure, minimum, and increment details clearly.
coaching_note: Skip the "Does that feel fair?" pause entirely and ask it explicitly with genuine silence before the ask—this call jumped straight from estimate explanation to pricing variants without checking customer comfort, then moved to close without ever asking if concerns from Section 2 were addressed.
